about: Every section that acts on its own has one employee who owns it and speaks for it in the Breakroom group chat (Brett, Nov 11 2026: "Every everything has to have an employee so she can communicate in the group chat"). `owner` is the default; Brett reassigns from Settings → Plugins → Agent swarm → Sections (kept in the plugin's data folder, never here). `where` says where the section lives (plain words: other plugins are never named by folder). `events` are the key moments it posts: start, done, failed, blocked, waiting (for Brett). Posting goes through framework/cli/crew-say.mjs; `crew-say.mjs check` (CI) fails when code posts for a section that is not here or has no owner on the crew.

sections.label: Build orchestrator
sections.about: Takes Brett's requests in: splits each build into steps and, when Launch builds without asking is on, moves it to the Queue.
sections.where: Build orchestrator: the dispatcher round, intake (split, auto-queue)

sections.label: Dispatcher (launch queue)
sections.about: Every minute: starts the next queued build on a free Claude account, moves to the next account when one refuses, closes builds whose session ended, says when nothing can run.
sections.where: Build orchestrator: the dispatcher round (launches, session ends, idle)

sections.label: Watchdog (self-check)
sections.about: Releases builds marked running that hold nothing, frees claims of ended sessions and expired limits, flags accounts it can't use.

sections.label: Shipped manifests
sections.about: After every dispatcher round: sends a shipped-feature manifest for each newly landed build.
sections.where: Build orchestrator: after each round; framework/cli/shipped.mjs

sections.label: Account failover
sections.about: When a Claude account hits its limit or its login fails mid-run: takes it out of the rotation and moves the run to the next account (or switches the console's account), so work carries on until it is back.

sections.label: Landing (auto-land)
sections.about: Every 3 minutes: gets finished builds ready to land (commits, merges main in, opens the PR, starts CI) and says what each one waits on.
sections.where: Push banner: the auto-land runner (cron every 3 minutes)

sections.label: Merge queue (test gate)
sections.about: Combines ready PRs into one batch, runs CI once on it, lands a green batch on main and kicks out the PR that turned it red.
sections.where: Push banner: the merge queue runner (same cron round)

sections.label: Nightly console deploy
sections.about: Rebuilds and redeploys the console at the set time each night when main changed in code.

sections.label: AXP backups
sections.about: Copies the live AXP folders to their private backup repos, scans for secrets, pushes what changed.

sections.label: Systems check monitor
sections.about: Every 15 minutes: runs every live health check, flags each new red item once, runs its auto-fix, says when it is green again.
sections.where: Systems check: the health monitor (every 15 minutes) and its auto-fixes

sections.label: Notification rules
sections.about: Brett's notification rules: fires a rule's own notification when its conditions are met.
